chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever recites 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' one hundred times when he takes his place to sleep, Allah will forgive him the sins of fifty years.

key_terms.حِینَ یَأْخُذُ مَضْجَعَهُ: When he takes his place to sleep
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad (Surah Al-Ikhlas, the chapter of monotheism)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas one hundred times before sleeping?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration in *Thawab al-A'mal*, emphasizing the efficacy of *Wird* (devotional repetition) as a means of spiritual purification before sleep. The promise of forgiving fifty years of sins underscores the transformative power of Surah Al-Ikhlas, which encapsulates the core of Tawhid (monotheism), in mitigating accumulated spiritual debts.
